test_coverage_notes: This code is core ledger iteration logic. Typical test coverage would be in integration and unit tests for directory traversal, such as in 'test/ledger/Directory_test.cpp', 'test/ledger/ReadView_test.cpp', or higher-level transaction/ledger tests. Direct validation paths (e.g., XRPL_ASSERTs, nullptr checks) are not always directly tested unless assertions are triggered by malformed data or edge cases (e.g., empty directories, missing SLEs, zero indexes). Gaps may exist in negative testing (e.g., what happens if sle_ is nullptr, or indexes_ is empty), and in coverage of multi-page directory traversal. Fuzzing or property-based tests may be needed for full validation path coverage.
